grammar.description: Grammar this tree was derived from.

Screen@screen.description: Root. One vertical scroll of sections with an optional header.

density.description: Global spacing scale the renderer applies to every component. A screen-wide presentation choice, not a per-card one.

Header@screen.description: Screen title bar with an optional utility action.

Section@screen.description: Binds one feed and establishes the `feed` context for its children.

heading.description: Always the feed name, so a heading can never disagree with its source.

Text@screen.description: A run of text bound to a context field or a string key.

Collection@feed.description: Repeater. Lays out feed items using an item template (and an optional lead template for the first item).

lead.description: Template for the first item only. Stack layouts only.

Button@feed.description: An action. Its label and icon are derived from `action` by the renderer, so they are not choices.
